title: US-short §12.2 shadow comparison TRACKED de-identified summary — the no-ticker selection-divergence view (§12.2 / §11.6 脱敏汇总)
description: Batch-3 TRACKED de-identified summary of a §12.2 shadow comparison (engine/us_short_shadow_compare_summary builds it from a comparison that passed validate_shadow_comparison). UNLIKE the PRIVATE comparison artifact (per-profile TopN selections WITH ticker names → gitignored via engine/us_short_shadow_compare_store, §11.6), this artifact carries ONLY normalized indicators — the per-shadow-profile selection-set DIVERGENCE COUNTS (balanced_only / shadow_extra / overlap), top_n / pool_size / selected_count, and the frozen ship-gate-isolation boundary — NO ticker names, NO $, NO performance — so it is safe to TRACK (§11.6 要 tracked 只能放脱敏汇总). additionalProperties:false everywhere + integer-only counts + const track/primary/boundary structurally guarantee no ticker / $ / performance detail can be smuggled into a tracked artifact, so engine/us_short_shadow_compare_summary validates a built / to-be-written summary against THIS schema as the de-identification gate (no §18.0 private-path guard is needed — being provably de-identified is exactly what §11.6 lets land on a tracked path). The divergence keys are const-pinned to the frozen shadow profiles. Structure-only: the as_of strict REAL-date (the pattern only checks 8 digits — it cannot reject an impossible calendar date like 20260231), selected_count == min(top_n,pool_size), and the welded per-profile `overlap+balanced_only == selected_count == overlap+shadow_extra` consistency are enforced by engine/us_short_shadow_compare_summary + tests. The paper-NAV two-way scorecard (§12.2 双向全口径) and the upgrade gate are later §12.2 cuts; this is the selection-level tracked companion of the private persister.
